description: This Java source file defines a custom ListView subclass 'InsertionListView' that manages animated insertion of rows and associated image animations, including handling of view bounds and drawable animations.

classes.name: InsertionListView
classes.description: A custom ListView subclass that supports animated insertion of rows with associated image animations and drawable bounds animations.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the ListView, setting divider to null, creating an overshoot interpolator, and initializing data structures.

methods.name: addRow
methods.description: Adds a new ListItemObject to the top of the list and performs complex animations including view position shifts and image pop-in.

methods.name: dispatchDraw
methods.description: Overrides dispatchDraw to draw bitmaps of views that are animating off-screen.

methods.name: shouldAnimateInNewRow
methods.description: Determines if the new row should animate in based on the current scroll position.

methods.name: shouldAnimateInNewImage
methods.description: Determines if the image in the new row should animate in.

methods.name: getBitmapDrawableFromView
methods.description: Creates a BitmapDrawable snapshot of a given view.

methods.name: getLocationOnScreen
methods.description: Returns the absolute screen coordinates of a view.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the data list for the ListView.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Sets the parent RelativeLayout for overlay animations.

methods.name: setRowAdditionAnimationListener
methods.description: Sets a listener for row addition animation events.
